title: Mirabel and the Archive
author: Lior Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Montrose, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
